verseText: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
intro: November is here! Give thanks to God, open your Bible, pray at home, help others, and enjoy this month's new CMBC coloring page and activity sheet.

read.title: Open Your Bible
read.text: Find Psalm 107:1. Read it out loud with somebody in your family. What does this verse tell us to do, and why?

move.title: Thankful Moves
move.text: Name three things you are thankful for. Reach up high for the first, stretch side to side for the second, and do a joyful jump for the third!

learn.title: Bible Challenge
learn.question: According to Psalm 107:1, why should we give thanks unto the LORD?
learn.answer: Because He is good, and His mercy endureth for ever! ❤️

artistWallMessage: November's Give Thanks to God coloring page and activity sheet are here!
completionMessage: 🏆 November Bible Adventure Complete! Keep giving thanks to God, praying, helping others, and growing in your faith!
